title: @floriandrevet/ng-template ng-new options
description: Creates a new Angular 22 workspace with the modernized application shell, and opt-in SSR, authentication, i18n, UI library, Docker and CI.

name.description: The name for the new workspace and the initial project.
name.x-prompt: What name would you like to use for the new project?

directory.description: The directory to create the workspace in. Defaults to the project name.

ssr.description: Enable Server-Side Rendering (SSR) and Static Site Generation.

ui.description: The UI library to set up.

x-prompt.message: Which UI library would you like to use?

auth.description: The authentication provider to set up.

x-prompt.message: Which authentication provider would you like to use?

docker.description: Add a multi-stage Dockerfile with runtime configuration injection.

ci.description: Add a GitHub Actions CI workflow (lint, test, build).
ci.x-prompt: Add a GitHub Actions CI workflow?

packageManager.description: The package manager used to install dependencies.

skipInstall.description: Skip the automatic installation of packages.

skipGit.description: Do not initialize a Git repository in the new workspace.
